title: Ines and the Crown
author: Paloma Iversen
blurb: Ines Ishikawa, a thief who steals memories, keeps the ledgers of a guild that trades in impossible things. Then a child arrives at the door speaking a language that predates kingdoms — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must reforge a broken covenant between realms before the moon completes its thirteenth turn.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
